full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white studio photograph frames a young adult man from the upper chest to just above his unruly dark curls. He faces the camera squarely and looks directly into the lens with a grave, unsmiling expression. His broad eyebrows, deep-set eyes, straight nose, textured cheeks, short facial stubble, and slightly compressed lips are rendered with unsparing clarity. The black neckline and shoulders of a plain shirt form a simple dark base at the bottom of the image. A smooth middle-gray background fills the space around his head, without props, environmental clues, markings, or text. His face occupies most of the frame and is almost perfectly centered; the hair reaches close to the top edge, while the shoulders are cropped symmetrically. The camera remains at eye height, with no flattering tilt or dramatic perspective. Soft frontal light, slightly stronger from camera left, reveals the unevenness of hair and skin while leaving gentle gray shadows around the jaw and beneath the curls. The grayscale range is broad but restrained: luminous forehead and nose, medium-gray skin, charcoal hair and shirt, and a muted background. Fine photographic grain and subtle softness in the outer curls keep the image natural. The result has the frank, administrative directness of a booking photograph, but the shallow tonal gradations and intense eye contact give it a quiet human presence. There is no date board, identification number, police badge, or other invented institutional detail in view.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形黑白影棚照片从上胸部裁到一名年轻成年男子蓬乱深色卷发上方。他正对镜头，直视镜头，神情凝重且没有笑意。宽眉、深眼、直鼻、带肌理的脸颊、短胡茬和微抿的嘴唇被毫不修饰地清楚呈现。素色衬衫的黑色领口和肩部在画面底部构成简单深色基座。平滑的中灰背景环绕头部，没有道具、环境线索、标记或文字。脸占据画面大部且几乎绝对居中；头发贴近顶缘，双肩对称裁切。相机位于眼睛高度，没有美化性的倾斜或戏剧化透视。柔和正面光从镜头左侧稍强地照来，显出发丝和皮肤的不平整，同时在下颌与卷发下面留下轻柔灰影。灰度范围宽但克制：明亮额头和鼻梁、中灰皮肤、炭黑头发与衬衫、低调背景。细微胶片颗粒和外侧卷发轻微柔化使影像自然。结果有登记照般坦率、行政化的直接感，而细腻的明暗过渡与强烈对视又赋予其安静的人性。画面没有日期牌、编号、警徽或其他虚构机构细节。
style_prompt_en: Use a direct monochrome studio-photography treatment built on frontality, centered framing, eye-level viewpoint, and a plain medium-gray field. Crop closely and symmetrically, allowing surface irregularities to remain visible instead of polishing them away. A soft, broad frontal light should reveal texture through fine tonal steps rather than theatrical shadow. Preserve a full grayscale scale with bright highlights, nuanced middle tones, and deep charcoal anchors. Keep the background free of decorative detail and let the focal form meet the viewer plainly. Add restrained photographic grain and slight natural optical softness at peripheral edges. The atmosphere is frank, still, and observational, with the strength of the image coming from unembellished presentation and precise attention to texture.
style_prompt_zh: 采用直接的单色影棚摄影处理，以正面性、居中构图、平视视点和纯中灰背景为基础。紧密而对称地裁切，让表面不规则之处保留可见，不加磨皮。宽而柔和的正面光应通过细小灰度层次显出肌理，而不制造戏剧化阴影。保留完整灰度尺度，包括明亮高光、丰富中间调与深炭色锚点。背景不加装饰细节，让焦点形体坦率地面对观者。加入克制的摄影颗粒和边缘轻微自然镜头柔化。氛围坦诚、静止而观察性强，画面的力量来自不加修饰的呈现及对肌理的精准关注。
theme_en: A curly-haired man facing the camera against a plain gray background
theme_zh: 卷发男子在纯灰背景前正面面对镜头
name: Mugshot
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
